nodes.label: Working Days and Deadlines
nodes.rationale: Thursday, Friday and registered official holidays are non-working; 'n working days' excludes the start day; month deadlines use the Solar Hijri calendar and clamp to month end; hourly deadlines are exact times.

nodes.label: Audit Log (سوابق ممیزی)
nodes.rationale: Security events and simple-history data changes are immutable even via direct SQL (PostgreSQL trigger); users with history are deactivated, never deleted; records kept at least five years and clean_old_history must never be run.

nodes.label: Banks and Services
nodes.rationale: Visibility is not restricted by bank because all users are Datin staff; RTO/MTPD/RPO recorded per service and bank in minutes, RTO >= 1 and < MTPD checked in the database; services, banks and their rows are deactivated or closed with valid-until instead of deleted.

nodes.label: Assets and Suppliers
nodes.rationale: Five asset types, optional data class, CIA label only marks which security property matters (per §8 of v5) and is not added to risk scoring.

nodes.label: Commitments (تعهدها)
nodes.rationale: SLA/contract/regulatory/internal obligations spanning several services; all fields but title optional so incomplete commitments can be recorded and completed later.

nodes.label: Dependencies and Responsibility Boundary
nodes.rationale: Each dependency targets exactly one of service, supplier or asset, enforced in the database; responsibility boundary has the five questions of §6 v5; single point of failure is flagged manually.

nodes.label: Assessment Methodology Version (نسخه‌ی روش)
nodes.rationale: All numbers, scales, tables, thresholds and rules live in the method version, not in code; exactly one active version (DB-enforced); v1 is a pilot built from v5; status only moves forward (draft, approved, active, archived) and non-draft content is immutable even via SQL; no version is ever deleted.

nodes.label: Bc Control-Reduction Table (§15)
nodes.rationale: One E2 control gives 4, E3 gives 3, E4/E5 gives 2, two independent E4/E5 controls give 1, none gives 5; when several rules apply the lowest Bc wins; v5 examples contradicting the table are corrected.

nodes.label: Impact Floor on Decision Level
nodes.rationale: Decision level is the level of score L x I unless the impact floor demands more: impact >= 4 at least medium, impact 5 at least high; the floor never changes the score itself.

nodes.label: Control Evidence Age Limits (90/180 days)
nodes.rationale: Key-control evidence expires after 90 days and other controls after 180 days from test end; both numbers come from the method version.

nodes.label: Calculation Engine (موتور محاسبه)
nodes.rationale: No methodology number lives in code; every value is read from the assessment's method version so a new version works without code changes and old assessments reproduce their result. Inputs may be numbers, ranges or unknown; the score is a range and decisions use its upper bound. Six v5 example results were raised after applying the Bc table.

nodes.label: Precedence Rules (قاعده‌های تقدم)
nodes.rationale: 'Event in progress' and 'binding prohibition' raise the decision level to the highest and keep the score; binding prohibition also puts the risk outside acceptance authority; 'customer tolerance breach' leaves the level but limits general acceptance authority.

nodes.label: Risk Universe (جهان ریسک)
nodes.rationale: Table with one row per active service and one column per active risk category (T1-T8, §5 v5); each cell is reviewed, not relevant (reason required, DB-checked) or pending; registering a risk marks a pending cell reviewed; risks cannot be registered in a not-relevant cell and a cell with active risks cannot become not relevant; each cell shows the visible active-risk count.

nodes.label: Critical Service Coverage Metric
nodes.rationale: Active critical services with no pending cell divided by all active critical services the user can see; commitments are covered through their services. The §21 management indicator is stricter.

nodes.label: Reference Scenario (سناریوی مرجع)
nodes.rationale: Generic risk template not bound to a service, asset or bank (§6 v5); auto code like SC-0012; never deleted and inactive scenarios cannot spawn risks; versioned by 'substantial change' and each risk keeps the version it was built from so the risk page warns on later changes.

nodes.label: Risk Register (رجیستر ریسک)
nodes.rationale: Each risk gets an auto code with the Solar Hijri year (RK-1405-0012) that restarts yearly and is never reused; a risk without scenario is a 'new item'; unit defaults to service owner unit and category to scenario category; GRC and admins edit, visibility follows service rules on the risk's own unit and owner.

nodes.label: Needs Completion Flag (نیازمند تکمیل)
nodes.rationale: Automatic flag that stays on until initiator, count unit and scope are written.

nodes.label: Risk Lifecycle (8 statuses, Q15)
nodes.rationale: Awaiting answers, registered, in assessment, rejected, treatment plan, in treatment, in review, closed; new risks start as registered; rejected and closed are not active; risks are never deleted.

nodes.label: External Link (پیوند بیرونی)
nodes.rationale: The same risk's identifier in another system (change, incident, problem, vulnerability, contract, supplier, continuity plan); one ref per kind per risk; links are edited, never deleted.

nodes.label: Intake Questionnaire (پرسشنامه‌ی ورودی)
nodes.rationale: GRC-defined questionnaires answered by unit managers (or by GRC as interview); responses start with fixed items and the eight identification questions of §4 v5; one open response per questionnaire/unit/service; returned responses have a five-working-day deadline.

nodes.label: Pending Risk (ریسک در انتظار)
nodes.rationale: Created on submission for each selected risk-indicator option and for the 'new item'; GRC converts it to a registered risk (transition 2) with prefilled fields or dismisses it with a reason.

nodes.label: Evidence (شاهد)
nodes.rationale: Document supporting the level or state of one or more risks (§20 v5); auto code EV-1405-0007; never deleted; has source, date, scope, reliability, valid-until (not before date, DB-checked), access class and owner; expired when valid-until passed; confidential evidence visible only to GRC, admin, scoped auditor, evidence owner and owners of its risks.

nodes.label: Attachments and Comments
nodes.rationale: Attachments max 20 MB with type whitelist and content sniffing, stored under random names outside the public folder and served by nginx after an access check; never deleted. Comments editable only by their author with history; never deleted.

nodes.label: Risk Workflow (گردش کار ریسک)
nodes.rationale: Status changes only through the Q15 transition table; each transition is kept immutably in the risk timeline with actor, time, reason and meeting date; the risk page shows only transitions possible from the current state and the user's role; rejected and closed are terminal.

nodes.label: Risk Questions (پرسش‌های ریسک)
nodes.rationale: Answered by the risk unit's managers (or recorded by GRC); five working day deadline, then shown overdue; never deleted.

nodes.label: Merge and Split Proposals (ادغام و تفکیک)
nodes.rationale: GRC proposes merge/split of an active risk with a reason (Q53); the risk owner approves or rejects with reason; ownerless risks cannot be merged/split and only one open proposal per risk. Merge closes the risk with a 'merged into' link keeping code and history; split keeps the origin and creates registered risks with new codes and 'split from' links copying key fields.

nodes.label: Controls and Statement of Applicability
nodes.rationale: Organization controls (CT-0007) with type, owner, performer, key-control flag and Annex A mapping; dual-purpose controls are registered as two; SoA has one row per Annex A control with mandatory reason; inconsistency warnings when not-applicable controls are mapped.

nodes.label: Assessment Types (inherent, current, target)
nodes.rationale: Inherent excludes specific controls, current is the decision basis, target forecasts post-action; AS-1405-0003 codes; method version active at creation is pinned; assessments are never deleted or overwritten.

nodes.label: Impact Profile (پروفایل پیامد)
nodes.rationale: One column for Datin and each affected bank; per dimension S, D, F, C, R a level 0-5 with reason and evidence; zero means no effect and unknown is never filled with zero; S suggested from outage duration vs RTO/MTPD (Q56), F from gross loss vs financial basis; suggestions need a reason to override; all-zero profile invalid; I is the max valid level.

nodes.label: Likelihood A (احتمال)
nodes.rationale: Two paths (§14): annual rate or forward-looking evidence, never summed or averaged; rate needs unique initiator count and observation months; insufficient data (period < 12 months, record coverage unknown or < 95%, zero events over too short a period) forces unknown or the forward-looking path.

nodes.label: Realization Path (مسیر تحقق)
nodes.rationale: Each assessment has one or more paths with steps, B0 (base capability without control credit) with reason and evidence, and preventive controls; bypasses are separate paths; barrier independence flag enables Bc=1; B = min(B0, Bc), scenario B = max over paths, L from the A x B table.

nodes.label: Control Effectiveness Assessment (E1-E5)
nodes.rationale: Records E of a control in a scope with the §25 test sheet (CA-1405-0001); E accepted only if all criteria of that and lower levels hold (E2 proven limited effect, E3 design and operation with >= 95% coverage and sample >= 30, E4 sustained records, E5 failure/bypass testing); suspended or stale evidence counts as E1.

nodes.label: Assessment Result and Quality Control
nodes.rationale: Result (L, I, score range, base and decision level, overall confidence) from the engine, recomputed for drafts and frozen on approval; cycle draft -> in QC -> referred to working group -> approved; reviewer must be a different GRC member who never submitted it; escalation causes recorded; risk page shows the latest approved current decision level.

nodes.label: Incomplete Assessment (ارزیابی ناقص)
nodes.rationale: An assessment whose unknown component could raise the result is incomplete: always low confidence, normal acceptance blocked, may be approved but cannot move the risk to treatment without a decision level.

nodes.label: Treatment Plan and Actions (TR codes)
nodes.rationale: One plan per approved current assessment that moved the risk to treatment; deadline from the §19 table (e.g. high 10 working days, critical 3 plus 24h containment); options reduce, avoid, transfer/share, accept, with accept forbidden for high/critical (Q63); actions approved by the risk owner; action statuses planned, approved, in progress, blocked, ready for test, verified, failed.

nodes.label: My Work Page (کارهای من)
nodes.rationale: Landing page listing the user's open actions, pending result verifications, plans awaiting owner approval, merge/split proposals, risk questions, assessments awaiting QC or committee, and for GRC risks in treatment ordered by level and deadline.

nodes.label: Time-Bound Risk Acceptance (AC codes)
nodes.rationale: Bound to the approved current assessment; validity capped by decision level (low 12 months, medium 6, high 90 days, critical 30); no automatic renewal; signatures from risk owner, unit manager (medium), security committee (high/critical), senior management (customer tolerance breach or incomplete critical service); silence is not acceptance; expires and is monitored.

nodes.label: Reassessment and Closure (بازسنجی و بستن)
nodes.rationale: After actions the risk goes to review and back to assessment; a plan with a newer approved current assessment awaits reassessment; comparison of base, new and target assessments with up/down arrows; target met if the new assessment is complete and not above target level or upper score bound.

nodes.label: v5 Compliance Completion
nodes.rationale: Re-validates E before crediting; snapshots key risk fields on approval; retirement needs evidence of path removal or legal/contractual exit; monitor_risks creates periodic, annual and expiry reviews; internal notifications with unique keys and escalation, no external mail; management report without sums or averages.

nodes.label: Management Report (گزارش مدیریتی)
nodes.rationale: Counts risks by latest current assessment, overdue high/critical actions, invalid acceptances, valid key controls, uncertainty, dependency concentration and level/method changes; never produces sums or averages of scores; scoped by user permissions.

nodes.label: Methodology Document v5 (سند v5)
nodes.rationale: Source methodology document (drafted 12 Mehr 1405) from which method version 1 was built; cited section by section across the business rules.
